title: Hardware Rig Configuration
description: Describes the PHYSICAL build: every LED, OLED, speaker, and haptic device that is actually wired up, and what pin/address/bus it lives on. This file has no game logic in it at all - it doesn't know what a 'team' or an 'objective' is. It only knows 'there is an LED at gpio17'. Theme files (see theme.schema.json) attach meaning to these physical ids via hardware_aliases. You should only need to touch this file when you physically rewire something.

rig_id.description: Stable identifier for this physical build, e.g. 'field-rig-v1'. Theme files can reference this in their own meta.compatible_rig as a sanity check - if it doesn't match, your engine can warn at load time that a theme was designed for a different rig.

_comment.description: Free-text note, ignored by the engine. JSON has no real comment syntax, so this is the workaround.

leds.description: One entry per physical LED (or addressable pixel). 'id' is the stable physical name every theme's hardware_aliases will point at.

id.description: Stable physical id, e.g. 'led_1'. Keep these theme-neutral (not 'alarm_led' or 'briefcase_led') since one physical LED gets reused for different narrative roles across themes.

device_id.description: Where your code actually finds this thing: a GPIO pin, an addressable-strip index, a driver-board channel, etc. Format is whatever your firmware/driver layer expects - this schema doesn't constrain it.

mqtt_topic.description: The MQTT topic to which this LED will subscribe for control messages.

location_note.description: Human-readable physical placement, e.g. 'North table, Objective A marker'. Purely documentation - helps you 5 themes from now when you forget what led_3 is.

device_id.description: e.g. an I2C address like '0x3C', or a bus+address pair however your driver expects it.

mqtt_topic.description: The MQTT topic to which this OLED will subscribe for control messages.

device_id.description: ALSA device name, sound card index, or whatever your audio backend takes.

mqtt_topic.description: The MQTT topic to which this audio output will subscribe for control messages.
The MQTT topic to which this haptic output will subscribe for control messages.
